How to Play

🌍

Your Mission

The planet EcoTerra is polluted and dying. As a Planet Guardian, complete five eco-friendly missions to restore it to health.

🧾

Eco Points

Earn Eco Points by completing challenges. The more points you earn, the higher your Guardian Rank will be.

🌱

Planet Health

Your actions directly affect planet health. Watch EcoTerra transform from polluted to green as you progress.

🏆

Badges

Collect special badges like Water Hero, Forest Guardian, and Pollution Fighter by excelling in each mission.

👥

Controls

Use mouse, touch, or keyboard. Click or tap objects to interact. Press P to pause during gameplay.

💾

Save Progress

Your progress is saved automatically. Close and return anytime to continue your journey.
